name: AnyMind Group Inc.
summary: AnyMind Group Inc. builds and delivers digital platforms supporting brand creation, product manufacturing, online sales, marketing and supply chain management. They help website and app publishers and content creators earn revenue and grow their brands. Core offerings include AnyX for e-commerce management and AnyFactory for manufacturing. Dating from 2016 with its base in Tokyo, it is a subsidiary of AnyMind Group Pte Ltd.
